name: K-Meleon
developer: Roy Tam (roytam1) maintains the Goanna builds; originally Christophe Thibault and the K-Meleon team
basedOn: Goanna (Gecko fork from the Pale Moon project) with a native Win32 interface
statusNote: 76.5.5 on Goanna 3.6.0 is described as the final planned release (Oct 2024). Roy Tam kept posting rolling builds (20241221 seen), and the SourceForge archive was re-uploaded on 2026-10-19. Windows only; modern sites often break.
updateCadence: Rolling and irregular; project calls 76.5.5 the final planned release
pitch: Tiny native Windows browser on the Goanna engine, with macros. Near its end of life.
summary: A lightweight Windows-only browser with a native Win32 interface, now on the Pale Moon-derived Goanna engine. It is highly scriptable through macros and runs on old Windows, but modern web apps mostly fail.
bestFor: Old Windows machines, including Windows XP and Vista
Tinkerers who like text-file configuration and macros
People who miss the lightweight Windows browsers of the 2000s
notFor: Anyone using modern web apps, social media or streaming
Users who need timely security updates
macOS, Linux or mobile users (Windows only, Linux only through Wine)

pros.title: Light and native
pros.detail: A Win32 shell with a small footprint and low memory use.

pros.title: Runs on very old Windows
pros.detail: Version 76 supports Windows XP and Vista; older builds ran on Windows 95 through 2000.

pros.title: Deep configuration
pros.detail: Toolbars, menus and shortcuts live in text files, and a macro language scripts the interface.

pros.title: Portable use
pros.detail: Distributed as a 34 MB 7z archive that runs without installing.

pros.title: No telemetry or business model
pros.detail: Volunteer-built with no data collection known.

cons.title: Declared end of line
cons.detail: Wikipedia says 76.5.5 is the final planned release as of October 2024, and the official site was not reachable to confirm newer plans.

cons.title: Old engine, weak compatibility
cons.detail: By 2023 it could not handle major web apps and social media sites; Goanna 3.6.0 is far from current engines.

cons.title: Weak security posture
cons.detail: No sandbox or site isolation, and fixes depend on one volunteer merging upstream work.

cons.title: Steep learning curve
cons.detail: Customising means editing macros and config files.

faq.a: Barely. 76.5.5 on Goanna 3.6.0 is described as the final planned release, though Roy Tam's rolling builds continued and the SourceForge archive was updated on 2026-10-19.
No. Since version 76 it uses Goanna, the Gecko fork created for Pale Moon.

faq.q: Will it run on Windows XP?
faq.a: Yes, version 76 supports Windows XP and Vista, which is its main reason to exist today.

windows.minOs: Windows XP (older builds ran on Windows 95-2000)

keyboardShortcuts: Shortcuts defined in text config files
devtools: View source and error console; unverified

memory: Low memory use is a stated trait
battery: Light, but old engine is not tuned

lookCustom: Skins and text-file toolbars and menus
webCompat: Cannot handle major web apps and social sites
openSource: GPL source; builds by one maintainer

beginnerFriendly: Macros and config files for customising
